provenance.sr_period_slots: OAI code (nr_radio_config.c set_SR_periodandoffset: sl10 when the first UL slot is < 10), recorded in the manifest
provenance.k2: min_rxtxtime = 6; every one of the paired grants in the SR runs had K2 = 6 slots
provenance.bler_target: OAI's UL BLER band 0.05-0.15 (midpoint); the measured first-transmission BLER under OLLA was 0.056 (median over positions)
provenance.ul_harq_rtt_slots: median slot gap from a failed PUSCH to its retransmission, 2801 inferred retransmissions in the HARQ runs with a working link (T-tracer, infer_crc); the engine fit ran with 5 (a lost-link run included), which does not change it: the latency runs at 0 dB had no retransmission
provenance.proactive_grant: OAI's stock ulsch_max_frame_inactivity = 10 grants after 100 ms without uplink, a period the engine has no knob for; the SR path dominates for traffic at 5 Hz or faster (stock and SR-only runs agree within 0.5 ms), so off
provenance.sr_grant_delay_slots: engine replay fit (tools/measure/calibrate.py --engine-fit) on the 11 stock-MAC latency runs, grid sr_grant_delay_slots 16-32 with proactive grants off: W1 8.41 ms, KS 0.32 (small frames 1.7-3.1 ms, 30 kB frames 19-41 ms); held out (Poisson 100 B, robot mix) W1 5.18 ms
provenance.proc_offset_ms: engine replay fit (tools/measure/calibrate.py --engine-fit) on the 11 stock-MAC latency runs, grid sr_grant_delay_slots 16-32 with proactive grants off: W1 8.41 ms, KS 0.32 (small frames 1.7-3.1 ms, 30 kB frames 19-41 ms); held out (Poisson 100 B, robot mix) W1 5.18 ms
provenance.fading: rfsim AWGN channel; the fit replayed without fading
provenance.calibration_knobs: none: the link-level fit (la_offset_db 24.4, bler_sinr_shift_db -12, slope 0.1, all at the edge of their grids) is not identifiable in rfsim, whose decoding failures come from the fixed-point sample path rather than from the configured noise (docs/bridges-oai.md)

metrics.source: OAI 2026.w39 rfsim, lena_match profile (51 PRB, DDDSU), stock MAC, lab box 2026-09-30
